subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should maintainers continue this original dirty draft, or make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 the canonical landing path for the Computer Use manifest contract after docs and security-boundary review?
rationale: The change is additive but creates public plugin API that future macOS host permission discovery will consume, and automation cannot choose the permanent field shape or canonical branch while both PRs are open.

options.title: Use the rebased successor
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 as canonical, complete docs and security-boundary review there, and retire this original draft only after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Ask the author to resolve conflicts, refresh the generated docs map, and keep this PR as the contract landing branch.

options.title: Pause the contract
options.body: Keep both draft branches parked until the macOS host-binding design is settled enough to publish a plugin manifest API.

recommendation.title: Use the rebased successor
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 as canonical, complete docs and security-boundary review there, and retire this original draft only after maintainer confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the rebased successor and has the strongest recent manifest metadata history for this contract shape.
